title: WhatsApp
description: Connect the business WhatsApp to send routes and orders to your delivery drivers. Just enter your number and scan the QR code with your phone.
status_unknown: The service could not be reached; showing the last known status.
load_error: The WhatsApp settings could not be loaded.
module_disabled_desc: The WhatsApp module is not enabled for your business. Contact support to activate it.
not_configured_desc: The WhatsApp service is not available yet. Contact support.
connection_desc: Use a number dedicated to the business: messages will be sent from it.
phone_hint: Include the country code, for example +57 for Colombia.
phone_invalid: Enter a valid number with country code (8 to 15 digits).
connect_error: The connection could not be started.
step_devices: Go to Settings → Linked devices → Link a device.
step_code: Tap “Link with phone number instead” and enter this code.
qr_error: The QR code could not be loaded. Request a new one.
qr_auto_refresh: The code refreshes automatically. This page detects when linking is done.
number_mismatch: The number {{connected}} was linked, which differs from the one you entered ({{expected}}). If it is not correct, change the number.
disconnect_confirm_desc: The number's session will be closed in this system and no messages can be sent until you connect it again.
calls_desc: The business number only sends messages; you can reject incoming calls.
reject_calls_hint: WhatsApp calls to this number are hung up automatically and the caller receives an automatic message saying this number only sends notifications.
test_desc: Send a message from the business WhatsApp to check that it works.
test_error: The test message could not be sent.
test_connect_first: Connect WhatsApp to send a test.
